# ScrapeOps

> ScrapeOps is a comprehensive web scraping platform that provides tools, APIs, and infrastructure to help developers build, manage, and scale web scrapers efficiently.

## About ScrapeOps

ScrapeOps offers a suite of web scraping tools designed to simplify the entire scraping workflow—from proxy management and anti-bot bypass to monitoring, scheduling, and structured data extraction. The platform aggregates multiple proxy providers, offers purpose-built monitoring for scrapers, and provides APIs that return structured JSON data from popular websites.

**Website:** https://scrapeops.io

## Products

### Proxy API Aggregator
An easy-to-use proxy API that routes requests through the best-performing proxy providers via a single endpoint. Features include anti-bot bypass (Cloudflare, DataDome, PerimeterX), JavaScript rendering, geo-targeting, residential/mobile proxies, and LLM-powered extraction.

### Residential & Mobile Proxy Aggregator
Access to premium residential and mobile proxies from multiple providers through a single proxy port. Supports country/city geo-targeting and sticky sessions.

### Scraper Monitoring & Alerts
Purpose-built monitoring for web scrapers with automatic stats aggregation, health checks, and alerts. Tracks pages scraped, items parsed, response codes, success rates, latencies, errors, and bandwidth.

### Server Manager & Job Scheduler
Deploy, manage, and schedule scrapers from a centralized dashboard. Supports SSH server integration and ScrapyD cluster management.

### MCP Server
Model Context Protocol server that exposes ScrapeOps Proxy API to AI IDEs (Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code, Windsurf). Enables AI agents to browse the web with proxy support.

### Parser API
Converts raw HTML from supported websites into structured JSON. Supports Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Target, Redfin, Zillow, Indeed, and search engines (Google, Bing, Yandex).

### Structured Data APIs
Direct API access to structured data from Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Redfin, and Indeed without needing to build parsers.

### n8n Integration
Official n8n node for integrating ScrapeOps web scraping capabilities into workflow automation.

### Fake User Agent & Headers API
Free API for generating random user agents and browser headers for web scraping.
